0022600182.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-3, 2-2 on the road, on a W1 streak) visit the Denver Nuggets (3-3, 1-2 at home, on an L1 streak) as the Raptors look to build on a 4-3 last ten games. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Jakob Poeltl is day-to-day with shoulder inflammation and a game-time decision, while Denver is missing Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Raptors lost 0-2, including a 121-115 loss in Denver on March 20, 2026.
